name: adr-039-xpath-sum-of-select
justification: ADR-039 (APPROVED 2026-08-28): an XPath sum() over a node set returns an XPath NUMBER, and a number cannot carry a row -- true whatever the feeding Select projects (a Select projecting whole rows would make sum(/r/v) return NaN, never a row). Pinned byte-for-byte: the backreference forces both body() calls to name the SAME Select action, the XPath expression is the literal sum(/r/v), and the inner if(empty(...)) guard is part of the template because XPath 1.0 sum() over an empty node set is NaN for the whole sum -- an unguarded form is rejected on purpose.
